title: OM-2: letting the compiler hold the contract
summary: OM-2 is an opt-in Omega profile: one om2 line, and the compiler holds checks that were comments before. Drake uses external byte layouts (error 29 on overlap), fresh scratch that cannot be read before it is written (error 27), and sealed types with a provable invariant (error 28). I'll show you each with om2 diag records, plus the guarantee matrix that says what is SUPPORTED and what is NOT ESTABLISHED.
goal: Opt into OM-2 and use layouts, fresh scratch and sealed types, reading the diagnostics and the guarantee matrix accurately.
key_steps: Put om2 (or om2 diag) as the first non-note line
Describe wire bytes with layout ... field F T at OFF little|big ... end
Mark scratch parameters fresh and write before you read
Seal abstract types only in their constructor
Read omc-diag, omc-site and omc-check records under om2 diag

example.code:
note header.om: an OM-2 unit. The compiler, not a comment, owns the byte layout
om2
layout hdr 8
field magic uint at 0 big
field size ushort at 4 little
field kind uchar at 6 little
field flags uchar at 7 little
end
fn mkhdr c edit hdr to void
put c magic 0x4f4d4547
put c size 512
put c kind 2
put c flags 0
end
fn main to int
c = new uchar 8 0
mkhdr c
note big-endian magic: the first four bytes spell OMEG
w = write 1 c 0 4
nl = new uchar 1 10
w = write 1 nl 0 1
note size 512 little-endian is the bytes 0 then 2
if ne get c 4 0
ret 1
end
if ne get c 5 2
ret 2
end
ret 0
end

omc-diag 1 code=29 sev=error line=5 col=24 span=160-166 expect=type found=6c6974746c65 obligation=layout profile=OM-2

omc: line 5: error 27
omc-diag 1 code=27 sev=error line=5 col=11 span=168-169 expect=value found=31 obligation=init profile=OM-2

compile diag rc=0
omc-site records: 15

compile stamp rc=0
run stamp rc=11
RESULT PASS

common_mistake: Using OM-2 words in an OM-1 unit (rotr is error 3, 0x10 is error 6 there) or treating an erased check as lost safety. Add the om2 line; erasure only happens for the exact proven constructor shape, and om2 diag reports kept or erased for every seal.
evidence_note: OM-2 units, refusals 27/28/29/3 and the tour (with om2 diag and two mutants) run on Linux AArch64 with omc befb8199...8a1d; reproduced byte for byte. Guarantee-matrix classes are quoted from the repository, not re-established here; no constant-time or hardware claim.
